title: "Can we reconstruct the FT Tubby B-17 within tolerance?"
---


::: {#d11dd88f .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 300.0      # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 187.4     # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Published target figures
b_target = 1.473
l_target = 1.168
m_target = 1.973
cg_target_rel = 0.108

# Model values
b_val = float(wing.span(type="y"))
l_val = float(fuse.length())
m_val = float(mass_props_dry.mass)
cg_val = float(mass_props_dry.x_cg - wing.xsecs[0].xyz_le[0])

# Target errors and tolerances
err_b = (b_val - b_target) / b_target * 100.0
err_l = (l_val - l_target) / l_target * 100.0
err_m = (m_val - m_target) / m_target * 100.0
err_cg = (cg_val - cg_target_rel) / cg_target_rel * 100.0

target_names = ["Wing span", "Fuselage length", "Dry weight", "Center of gravity"]
errors = [err_b, err_l, err_m, err_cg]
tolerances = [1.0, 2.0, 6.0, 8.0]

worst_idx = int(np.argmax(np.abs(errors)))
worst_abs_err = abs(errors[worst_idx])
worst_target = target_names[worst_idx]
worst_tol = tolerances[worst_idx]
```

**Answer.** Yes. Reconstructed geometry reproduces every published target well within tolerance, with a worst error of [5\.86%]{.key} on center of gravity against its [±8\.0%]{.key} limit. Wing span matches at [1473 mm]{.key} ([\-0\.00%]{.key}), and fuselage length at [1168 mm]{.key} ([\+0\.00%]{.key}). Dry weight reaches [1990 g]{.key} ([\+0\.86%]{.key}), with dry CG [101\.7 mm]{.key} aft of root leading edge ([\-5\.86%]{.key}). Overlaid on the store photograph (@fig-photo-overlay), the four tractor nacelles, dihedral, and wide fuselage align closely with the airframe. Target errors are summarized in (@fig-target-errors).

``` {.python .cell-code}
fig_err, ax_err = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 3.2))
y_pos = np.arange(len(target_names))
tol_bands = np.array(tolerances)

ax_err.barh(y_pos, 2 * tol_bands, left=-tol_bands, color="lightgray", alpha=0.5, height=0.55, label="Tolerance band")
ax_err.barh(y_pos, errors, color="steelblue", height=0.35, label="Model error")
ax_err.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")
ax_err.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_err.set_yticklabels(target_names)
ax_err.set_xlabel("Error [%]")
ax_err.set_xlim(-10, 10)
ax_err.legend(loc="lower right")
ax_err.grid(True, axis="x", alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
